body: Inputs from SEC XBRL (10-K 0001375365-26-000022, 0001375365-25-000027), $m. FY2024 vs FY2023: DSRI 1.133, GMI 1.310 (GM 18.01% -> 13.75%), AQI 0.876, SGI 2.104, DEPI 1.252, SGAI 0.857, LVGI 0.968 (total liabilities/assets simplification), TATA 0.370 ((NI 1,152.7 - CFO -2,486.0)/TA 9,826.1). M = -4.84 + 1.042 + 0.692 + 0.354 + 1.877 + 0.144 - 0.147 + 1.733 - 0.317 = +0.54 (flag > -1.78). Other years: FY23 -1.94 (grey), FY25 -2.32 (clean: receivables fell, CFO +1,660), FY26 +0.07 (DSRI 1.56: receivables +178% vs revenue +78%; TATA 0.30; CFO -6,810 on NI 2,230). Context visible at the time: 2018 8-K 4.02 non-reliance; Aug-2020 SEC $17.5m penalty for improper revenue recognition; Hindenburg report 27-Aug-2024; delayed 10-K; EY resignation 8-K 4.01 (30-Oct-2024); BDO appointed (18-Nov-2024); special committee found no misconduct evidence; 10-K filed Feb-2025. Lesson: FY24 M was driven by SGI and TATA (hyper-growth funded by inventory) - a known false-positive mode - so M alone was not proof; M + prior restatement + auditor exit = three red-flag families = no position without variant view.

data.lesson: combine score with governance flags; growth causes false positives

Period split: pledge-only H12 2.27 (2018-21) vs 1.10 (2022-25); ICR-only 1.21 vs 3.25 - single flags swap roles by regime; 'both' 3.5x/3.7x in both. P (2016/18 survivorship-free snapshots): pledge-only winners 0.67 [0.15,1.41], H12 1.67 [0.76,3.08]; both O_fail 4.41 [2.81,7.44], XS156 -45pp [-85,-7]; B50 XS156 -42pp. Rule T (tighten pledge -> 0 new money) failed for pledge-only, >50% and both; Rule L (loosen ICR-only) failed. Decision: keep card v1.3/v1.4 unchanged; no patch. Post-hoc (needs own test on 2026+ events): grade by number of flags, not type. Research, not SEBI-registered advice.
